changelog: Added AuraOS 2.0, a brand-new 3rd operating system inspired by Xiaomi HyperOS with custom squircle icons, HyperOS Control Center, capsule status bar, restyled apps, and Aura 15 Ultra devices.
Centered the /conf_acn_phone admin panel window and fixed the input focus/blinking bug so all text fields (block reason, device editor, etc.) work smoothly.
